mitosis.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (mitotic OR mitosis) AND FIG:(prophase AND anaphase)

aberr.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (genotoxic* OR "chromosomal aberrations" OR "chromosome aberrations") AND FIG:(bridge* OR sticky OR laggard* OR "c-mitosis" OR "c-metaphase")

micronuc.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND FIG:(micronucle* OR "nuclear bud*" OR binucleate*)

metals.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (cadmium OR lead OR copper OR mercury OR chromium OR nickel OR "heavy metal*") AND FIG:(aberration* OR anaphase OR micronucle* OR bridge*)

nano.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND nanoparticle* AND FIG:(aberration* OR anaphase OR micronucle* OR root* OR mitotic)

pest.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (pesticide* OR herbicide* OR insecticide* OR fungicide* OR glyphosate OR atrazine) AND FIG:(aberration* OR anaphase OR bridge* OR mitotic)

pharma.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (drug* OR pharmaceutical* OR antibiotic* OR anticancer OR cyclophosphamide OR "methyl methanesulfonate") AND FIG:(aberration* OR anaphase OR micronucle*)

extracts.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (extract* OR "essential oil*") AND (genotox* OR cytotox* OR antimutagen*) AND FIG:(aberration* OR anaphase OR mitotic OR micronucle*)

myco.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (mycotoxin* OR aflatoxin* OR ochratoxin OR fumonisin* OR zearalenone OR deoxynivalenol OR patulin OR Fusarium OR Aspergillus OR Penicillium)

cyano.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (microcystin* OR cylindrospermopsin OR cyanobacteri* OR cyanotoxin* OR Microcystis)

protect.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (antimutagen* OR antigenotox* OR probiotic* OR Lactobacillus OR Saccharomyces OR Chlorella OR Spirulina OR Trichoderma OR "plant growth promoting")

roots.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (toxicity OR phytotoxicity) AND FIG:("root length" OR "root growth" OR "onion bulbs" OR "bulbs" OR "roots of")

salt.epmc: "Allium cepa" AND (NaCl OR salinity OR "salt stress" OR drought OR "heat stress") AND FIG:(aberration* OR mitotic OR anaphase OR root*)
